title: Imma Probable NDE 3104
content: I was hospitalized because my child was dead in utero. I was 8 months along. On my way to practice birthing, I felt as if I would faint and I told the doctors that I was leaving my body. Upon awakening I explained to my family that I had risen to a sort of meadow--very green--and that I'd seen deceased family members.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Childbirth . They didn't succeed at resuscitating me. According to the case history, they were trying to resuscitate me for 15 or 20 minutes.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | A landscape or city
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes That my daughter needed me and I had to return.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm UN PRADO ENORME Y MUY VERDE
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I value people more: my mate, my children.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Disoriented, perhaps because of the quantity of medications I was given.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes My intuition is more evolved.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They understood me; others believed in this.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real. The first few days I remembered everything. After two weeks, I remembered, each time, less details.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was probably not real. Because perhaps the medications that they gave me made me dream.
